unaided_1_to_frontier_fresh.interpretation: Each run has the same 900-second wall allowance. Tool access and native inference differ, so this is neither an equal-compute comparison nor a causal estimate of tool benefit.

frontier_fresh_to_cumulative.interpretation: Cumulative inherits its own fresh archive and receives another allowance; this is a lineage comparison, not equal total compute.

unaided_replicate_variability.interpretation: Two independent unaided attempts are separate prespecified replicates. No best-of-two pooling is used as a single-attempt condition.
